Name: Eidee Easy Fishing
Author: EideeHi
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#3a9bdc][b]EIDEE EASY FISHING[/b][/color][/size]
[i]Customizable mod for easy fishing[/i]
[size=3][i]Since v1.3.0, this mod is developed primarily with the assistance of AI.[/i][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]About[/b][/color][/size]
This mod was created to make fishing easier. You can customize everything from the config — skip the minigame, make the minigame easier, always find treasure, always catch double fish,
catch any fish regardless of season, and more.

[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]Configuration[/b][/color][/size]
The config file is generated by starting the game once, at:
[b][u]Stardew Valley/Mods/EideeEasyFishing/config.json[/u][/b]

[b]Using a mod manager (MO2, etc.)?[/b] The config file may not appear in the Stardew Valley game directory, because mod managers use a virtual file system to load mods. In that case,
look for config.json inside the mod's installation folder managed by your mod manager. [b]Mod manager users are recommended to use Generic Mod Config Menu (below)[/b], so you can edit
every setting in game without having to find the file at all.

In game, press [b]F5[/b] to reload the config and [b]F6[/b] to toggle the whole mod on/off. Both keys can be customized.

The easiest way to edit everything is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]:
[center][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eideehi/sdv-easyfishing/main/docs/images/config-menu.jpg[/img][/center]

[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]General Options[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Mod Enabled[/b] — Master switch for the entire mod; disables every feature below until re-enabled (also toggled in game with F6).[/*]
[*][b]Bite Faster[/b] — Waiting for fish to bite the bait is no longer necessary.[/*]
[*][b]Hit Automatically[/b] — No need to click to start the minigame. With "Skip Minigame" enabled, the fish is caught automatically.[/*]
[*][b]Treasure Always Be Found[/b] — Treasure is guaranteed on every attempt, even with "Skip Minigame" enabled.[/*]
[*][b]Always Golden Treasure[/b] — Whenever treasure appears, whether naturally or forced, it is always a golden treasure chest.[/*]
[*][b]Always Caught Double Fish[/b] — Using Wild Bait always results in catching two fish.[/*]
[*][b]Caught Double Fish On Any Bait[/b] — Adds the double-fish chance to any bait used; combinable with "Always Caught Double Fish".[/*]
[*][b]Fish Appear Regardless of Season[/b] — Catch fish that would normally be unavailable due to season or location, just like Magic Bait.[/*]
[*][b]Higher Chance for Rare Fish[/b] — Makes harder-to-find fish more likely to bite, just like a Curiosity Lure.[/*]
[*][b]Always Max Cast Power[/b] — Casting power is always at its maximum.[/*]
[/list][size=3][i]⚠ "Fish Appear Regardless of Season" and "Higher Chance for Rare Fish" are the only options that change which fish is selected, and are silently disabled in multiplayer (the
rod's attachment slots are network-synced). All other options work normally in multiplayer.[/i][/size]

[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]Minigame Options[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Skip Minigame[/b] — The minigame is skipped and fish are caught automatically, always a perfect catch.[/*]
[*][b]Fish Easy Caught[/b] — The fish icon automatically chases the bar.[/*]
[*][b]Treasure Easy Caught[/b] — The treasure icon automatically chases the bar.[/*]
[*][b]Always Reveal Fish Type[/b] — Shows which fish you are catching, even without a Sonar Bobber equipped.[/*]
[*][b]Always Max Fish Quality[/b] — Forces every catch to Iridium quality, ignoring Quality Bobber count, rod tier, and perfect-catch requirements.[/*]
[*][b]Always Max Fish Size[/b] — Forces every catch to its maximum recorded length, ignoring rod tier and the per-frame size penalty during the minigame.[/*]
[/list][i]Multipliers (default values shown):[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Fish Movement Speed Multiplier[/b] — Multiplier for the fish's movement speed in the minigame. (default 0.5)[/*]
[*][b]Progress Bar Decrease Multiplier[/b] — How quickly the capture progress bar decreases. (default 0.5)[/*]
[*][b]Progress Bar Increase Multiplier[/b] — How quickly the capture progress bar increases. (default 1.25)[/*]
[*][b]Treasure Catch Speed Multiplier[/b] — Multiplier for how fast treasure is caught. (default 1.5)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]Controls[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Reload Config[/b] — Key for reloading the configuration. (default F5)[/*]
[*][b]Toggle Mod[/b] — Key for turning the entire mod on or off at runtime. (default F6)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][color=#3a9bdc][b]Manual config.json[/b][/color][/size]
If the config file is not generated, you can create it manually:
[spoiler]
[code]{
  "Enabled": true,
  "BiteFaster": false,
  "HitAutomatically": false,
  "SkipMinigame": false,
  "FishEasyCaught": false,
  "TreasureAlwaysBeFound": false,
  "AlwaysGoldenTreasure": false,
  "TreasureEasyCaught": false,
  "AlwaysCaughtDoubleFish": false,
  "CaughtDoubleFishOnAnyBait": false,
  "AlwaysMaxCastPower": false,
  "AlwaysSonarBobber": false,
  "AlwaysMaxFishQuality": false,
  "AlwaysMaxFishSize": false,
  "AlwaysMagicBait": false,
  "AlwaysCuriosityLure": false,
  "FishMovementSpeedMultiplier": 0.5,
  "ProgressBarDecreaseMultiplier": 0.5,
  "ProgressBarIncreaseMultiplier": 1.25,
  "TreasureCatchSpeedMultiplier": 1.5,
  "Controls": {
    "ReloadConfig": "F5",
    "ToggleMod": "F6"
  }
}[/code][/spoiler]
